intent: Translate between a selected base language and translation language in both directions according to each spoken utterance, with a separately selected streaming voice for each output language. English/Azelma and French/Estelle are the requested example.
constraints: Keep questions, commands and quoted instructions as source text to translate, never as actions to perform.
Preserve isolated translation context, no tools, privacy policy and cancellation ownership.
Retain the published microphone pulse, first-entry listening and spoken-reply continuation behavior.
Base implementation on the latest PR branch and preserve concurrent commits.
Do not claim language recognition or physical playback capabilities without supporting implementation and qualification.

behavior.direction: Classify each finalized or edited transcript locally before submitting the existing isolated source-translation request; explicit spoken-language selection can resolve uncertain text.
behavior.unknownSource: Keep the draft for review with actionable language selection; no guessed direction or provider request.
behavior.capture: Android on-device bilingual capture requires API34+, a compatible service and both installed locales. Explicit English can retain installed Moonshine; other explicit sources use Android.
behavior.voiceFactory: Immutable per-turn Pocket Multilingual CPU factory with the exact saved language/voice; explicit pack installation and no global backend preference mutation.
behavior.playback: Fixed accepted target policy owns replay; missing metadata defers automatic admission. Required local output prevents system-voice substitution.
behavior.cancellation: Draft generation, text, phase and access fence preparation. Replay preparation has a separate generation owner invalidated by Stop, settings, background and benchmark ownership.

integratedVoiceCore.scope: Actual session, pair, fixed policy, playback helper and ledger, source isolation; explicit unrelated host ports.

settingsAndBackend.scope: Preference migration and persistence, exact multilingual factory selection without ordinary preference mutation; explicit storage/native ports.

detectorAndRecognitionPolicy.scope: Actual detector lifecycle/confidence policy and pair qualification against pinned Android/MediaPipe APIs; no Android service execution.

nativeLanguageModel.scope: Pinned bundled detector; English/French/outside-pair/ambiguous text. Mixed-language detection is not guaranteed.

androidComposeApi.scope: Full changed dialog, conversation controls, microphone and two exact instrumentation methods; no device execution.

rootTranslationWiring.scope: Exact screen helpers/effects/prepareDraft and runtime detector statements against actual integrated APIs; not whole-screen or full Android compilation.

strictVoiceRecovery.scope: Full VoicePluginAudioTest against actual integrated production sources and explicit host ports; strict streaming/nonstreaming failure rejects Android fallback, ordinary fallback and cancellation remain covered.

canonicalHostGate.reasonForInitialRetry: The new translation settings instrumentation method was initially missing from the acceptance receipt list; it was added without weakening the receipt requirement, and the full gate passed.

ktlint.formattingCorrection: One required empty line before a VoiceSession KDoc. Exact whitespace-only proof is retained with the original behavioral test receipts.

fullAndroid.reason: Required verified RAM/cgroup headroom is unavailable. The memory guard is retained.

changedSourceSecrets.scope: Changed-source snapshot at final integration; hosted reachable-history scan remains separate.

limitations: Automatic bilingual ASR depends on Android14+, an on-device service implementing language switching, and installed support for both selected locales.
Text detection cannot repair misrecognized audio or reliably identify every short or mixed-language utterance. Explicit source selection remains available.
Azelma and Estelle require explicit installation of the Pocket Multilingual CPU pack. English-only and compiled GPU/NPU packs do not provide the paired voices.
Host ports and API compilation do not establish full Android, physical microphone, JNI playback, acoustic quality, caption timing, device latency or hosted CI qualification.

Accepted output language is persisted through the existing fixed response policy. Replay uses that language with the currently configured matching voice; a per-message voice ID is not newly persisted.

publication.method: Content-addressed Git tree with expected-head lease; preserve newer remote commits before publication.
